channel.title: Aaditya Chauhan — Writing
channel.description: Articles on search, information retrieval, and RAG systems by Aaditya Chauhan.

item.title: Why Vector Search Alone Isn't Enough: Hybrid Retrieval for RAG
item.description: Discussing the limitations of vector-only RAG pipelines and how combining BM25 with vector search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion enhances retrieval quality in production.

item.title: Your Embedding Model Will Deprecate. Here's What to Do.
item.description: Every embedding model gets deprecated eventually. A practitioner's guide to migrating a production RAG pipeline without breaking search quality or your budget.

item.title: From Exact kNN to DiskANN: The Evolution of High-Performance Vector Search
item.description: After years building search systems at hundreds of billions of records, here's what I learned about scaling vector search from kNN to HNSW to DiskANN.

item.title: The Math Behind the Match: Building Production Search for People Names
item.description: A deep dive into the algorithms and engineering tradeoffs behind building a people-name search system at production scale.

item.title: AI is Disrupting Everything: Should You Even Study Computer Science?
item.description: Exploring whether a CS degree still makes sense in an era where AI is reshaping the software engineering profession.
